column3: Close to the Hebrew; “from his heart” is rendered “willingly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the land” is rendered “the earth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the Lord has not seen” is rendered “The Lord does not approve.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the troubles and the good” is rendered “woe and well-being.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for his sins” is rendered “for the punishment of his sins.”
Close to the Hebrew; “our heart to the palms” is rendered “our hearts and hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a pit” is rendered “a snare.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my eye has dealt severely with my soul” is rendered “My eyes bring suffering to my soul.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they destroyed my life” is rendered “They silenced my life,” and “a stone” “stones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my relief” is rendered “my sighing.”
